passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: I get up at seven, and I wash my face.
phrases.ko: 나는 일곱 시에 일어나고, 얼굴을 씻어요.
phrases.py: wǒ qī diǎn qǐ chuáng， rán hòu xǐ liǎn。
fàng xué hòu wǒ zuò zuò yè。

phrases.en: I eat dinner with my family.
phrases.py: wǒ hé jiā rén yì qǐ chī wǎn fàn。
rán hòu wǒ qù shuì jiào。
zhè jiù shì wǒ de yī tiān。

phrases.en: I get up at seven because school starts early.
phrases.ko: 학교는 일찍 시작해서 나는 일곱 시에 일어나요.
phrases.zh: 我七点起床，因为学校开始得很早。
phrases.py: wǒ qī diǎn qǐ chuáng， yīn wèi xué xiào kāi shǐ dé hěn zǎo。

phrases.en: I wash my face, and then I feel awake.
phrases.ko: 나는 얼굴을 씻고, 그다음에 정신이 맑아져요.
phrases.zh: 我洗了脸，然后觉得清醒。
phrases.py: wǒ xǐ le liǎn， rán hòu jué de qīng xǐng。

phrases.en: Breakfast gives me energy for school.
phrases.py: zǎo fàn gěi wǒ shàng xué de lì qì。

phrases.en: After homework and dinner, I sleep well.
phrases.ko: 숙제와 저녁 후에 나는 잠을 잘 자요.
phrases.zh: 做完作业、吃完晚饭，我就睡得很好。
phrases.py: zuò wán zuò yè、 chī wán wǎn fàn， wǒ jiù shuì de hěn hǎo。

full_passage_spoken: I get up at seven, and I wash my face. I eat breakfast. I go to school. I do homework after school. I eat dinner with my family. Then I sleep. This is my day. I get up at seven because school starts early. I wash my face, and then I feel awake. Breakfast gives me energy for school. After homework and dinner, I sleep well.
full_passage_zh: 我七点起床，然后洗脸。我吃早饭。我去上学。放学后我做作业。我和家人一起吃晚饭。然后我去睡觉。这就是我的一天。我七点起床，因为学校开始得很早。我洗了脸，然后觉得清醒。早饭给我上学的力气。做完作业、吃完晚饭，我就睡得很好。
